import os,re,json,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for p in ('1','2'):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; e=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    threes=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if inp[i][j]==3]
    rs=[c[0] for c in threes]; cs=[c[1] for c in threes]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    def run(seeds):
        q=collections.deque(seeds); vis=set(seeds); lvl={s:0 for s in seeds}; res=[]
        while q:
            a,b=q.popleft(); v=lvl[(a,b)]
            for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                x,y=a+di,b+dj
                if r0<=x<=r1 and c0<=y<=c1 and inp[x][y]==0 and (x,y) not in vis:
                    vis.add((x,y)); lvl[(x,y)]=v+1; res.append((x,y))
        return [(k,lvl[k]) for k in lvl]
    A=run(threes)
    mism=sum(1 for (k,v) in A if e[k[0]][k[1]]!=v)
    B=run({c for c in threes if c[0] in (r0,r1) or c[1] in (c0,c1)})
    m2=sum(1 for (k,v) in B if e[k[0]][k[1]]!=v)
    print('pair',p,'all-3-seeds mismatches:',mism,'/',len(A),' ; per-only:',m2,'/',len(B))

import os,re,json,numpy as np
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
Gi=G['Demo pair 3 input']; Go=G['Demo pair 3 output']
T=G['Test input']
It=np.array(Gi); Ot=np.array(Go); Tt=np.array(T)
H,W=It.shape
rs=[r for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if It[r,c]==3]
cs=[c for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if It[r,c]==3]
r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
def pred(I):
    r0c=max(r for r in range(I.shape[0]) for c in range(I.shape[1]) if I[r,c]==3)
    rs_=sorted(set(r for r in range(I.shape[0]) for c in range(I.shape[1]) if I[r,c]==3))
    cs_=sorted(set(c for r in range(I.shape[0]) for c in range(I.shape[1]) if I[r,c]==3))
    R0,R1,C0,C1=rs_[0],rs_[-1],cs_[0],cs_[-1]
    res=[]
    for r in range(I.shape[0]):
        row=[]
        for c in range(I.shape[1]):
            if I[r,c]==3: row.append(3)
            elif c>C0 and c<C1 and r>R0 and r<R1:
                row.append(4 if ((c-C0)%2==0 and (r-R0)<(R1-R0)) else 2)
            else: row.append(0)
        res.append(row)
    return res

res=pred(Tt)
print(json.dumps(res))

import os,re,json,numpy as np
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); Gi=np.array(G['Demo pair 3 input']); Go=np.array(G['Demo pair 3 output'])
Tt=np.array(G['Test input'])
ys,xs=np.where(Gi==3); r0,r1,c0,c1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
print('bbox:',r0,r1,c0,c1,'shape',Gi.shape)
# Verify exact output interior
for r in range(r0+1,r1):
    print('row',r-r0,'in', ''.join(map(str,Gi[r,c0:c1])), '| out', ''.join(map(str,Go[r,c0:c1])))
# Test candidate functions, report ALL mismatches incl. wall cells
def cand(f, name):
    mism=[]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            rr,cc=r-r0,c-c0
            exp=f(rr,cc)
            act=int(Go[r,c])
            if exp!=act: mism.append((rr,cc,exp,act))
    print(name,'mismatches:',len(mism), mism[:8])

import numpy as np, os,re,collections,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); gi=np.array(G['Demo pair 3 input']); go=np.array(G['Demo pair 3 output'])
# find actual bounding box of 3s
ys,xs=np.where(gi==3); r0,r1,c0,c1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
print('bbox',r0,r1,c0,c1,'walls in bbox:',np.sum(gi[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]==3),'out non-3:',[(int(go[r,c]), int(gi[r,c])) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if int(go[r,c])!=3][:15])
